name: agentguards
description: Official AgentGuards marketplace — LLM security guardrails for AI coding agents.

plugins.name: agentguards-claude
plugins.description: LLM security guardrails for Claude Code: jailbreak/prompt-injection detection, web-content scanning, data-exfiltration blocking, and destructive-command authorization.

plugins.name: agentguards
plugins.description: FOR THE CLAUDE PLUGIN DIRECTORY ONLY — installing from this marketplace? Install agentguards-claude instead, and never both. This is the directory edition of agentguards-claude: the same guardrails, but it never answers a permission prompt for you, so Claude Code asks before commands agentguards-claude would let run.

plugins.name: agentguards-claude-selfhosted
plugins.description: LLM security guardrails for Claude Code, for a self-hosted AgentGuards appliance: jailbreak/prompt-injection detection, web-content scanning, data-exfiltration blocking, and destructive-command authorization, enforced entirely by hooks (no bundled MCP server, so it never talks to AgentGuards' hosted service by accident).
